# Stable model API

Users fit either scientific engine through `fit_eivgp()`, predict supported
statistical targets through `predict_eivgp()` or `predict()`, and obtain latent
input draws through `impute_eivgp()`. Published competitors have matching
package-facing wrappers.

```{r copy-public-api, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts",
  "00_public_api.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```

```{r public-api-example, eval=FALSE}
fit <- eivGP::fit_eivgp(
  X, y, C, U_obs,
  engine = "multivariate",
  latent_dim = 2L,
  kernel = "matern"
)
mean_draws <- eivGP::predict_eivgp(
  fit, new_X = X_new, new_C = C_new, target = "mean"
)
response_draws <- predict(
  fit, new_X = X_new, new_C = C_new, target = "response"
)
latent_draws <- eivGP::impute_eivgp(fit, new_C = C_new)
```
